claims.text: The minutes of the sitting of Tu'apulelulu (Thursday) 12 Sepitema 2019 (from 10:05) list ''Eiki Palēmia: Samuela 'Akilisi Pōhiva' among the Cabinet members of the House. Under the heading 'Poupou ke lotua mo hūfia e Palēmia 'o Tonga', Lord Tu'i'āfitu supports the Deputy Prime Minister's request of the previous day for prayer for the Prime Minister. At 11:15-11:20 the Acting Speaker, Lord Tu'ilakepa, adjourns the House until further notice.
claims.locator: PDF page 2 (members list); page 7 (heading and Lord Tu'i'āfitu); page 19 ('Toloi toki fanongonongo e Fale Alea')
claims.uncertainty: The members list is a roster, not an attendance record. The minutes do not state the Prime Minister's condition, location or death, and do not give a reason for the adjournment. They are not used to date the death. The English rendering is this packet's reading.
